bullets.text: Personal auto rates increased across 36 states representing ~75% of TTM premium, a ~7% countrywide increase; nearly 7 points remain to earn in during 2022; underwriting restrictions and bill plan limits continued.
Companywide CR was 94.5, up 5.2 points YOY; PL CR 95.2, with personal auto about one point above 96 target excluding special lines; CL CR 90.5; Property CR 98.5.
Average loss costs increased almost 18% YOY in personal auto; collision, property damage, and total loss payouts were pressured by general inflation and used car prices rising about 35% YOY.
NPW grew 12% YOY; PL NPW +3%; CL NPW +63%, crossing $9B on a TTM basis and aided by TNC policy terms shifting to 12 months; Property NPW grew 13%.
Companywide PIF +3% YOY; personal auto PIF slowed to +1% due to significantly lower new applications following rate actions; CL PIF +16% to nearly 1M; Property PIF rose 9%.

Issued $1.5B senior unsecured notes to prudently restore historical leverage; investment portfolio returned (3.8)%, with fixed income at (3.6)% and equities at (4.9)% amid rising interest rates and volatility.

Property CR included 17.8 points of catastrophe losses from March wind, hail, and tornadoes in Texas and the Southeast; intentional growth cutbacks caused Florida and hail belt homeowners PIF to shrink.

Personal auto model 8.7 deployed in 27 states (60% countrywide premium), improving quote conversion; BOP expanded to 36 states; heavy truck roadside assistance launched in seven states covering ~20% of eligible vehicles.
Advertising spend decreased 8% YOY in the first quarter of 2022; higher 2021 ad spend contributed to the prior-year period's exceptionally high new business volume.

The Golden Rule core value illustrated by an internal employee assistance story during travel disruptions; Progressive marked its 85th anniversary on March 10, 2022, honoring founders Joe Lewis and Jack Green.
